import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().splitlines()
    
    if not data:
        return
    
    N, T = map(int, data[0].split())
    
    B1 = [['#' for _ in range(13)] for _ in range(13)]
    B2 = [['#' for _ in range(13)] for _ in range(13)]
    
    for r in range(1, N+1):
        line = data[r]
        for c in range(1, N+1):
            B1[r][c] = line[c-1] if c-1 < len(line) else '#'
        B1[r][N+1] = '#'
    
    for r in range(1, N+1):
        line = data[N + r]
        for c in range(1, N+1):
            B2[r][c] = line[c-1] if c-1 < len(line) else '#'
        B2[r][N+1] = '#'
    
    B = [['#' for _ in range(13)] for _ in range(13)]
    scientists = []
    capsules = []
    z = None
    
    for r in range(1, N+1):
        for c in range(1, N+1):
            if B1[r][c].isdigit():
                if B1[r][c] > '0':
                    scientists.append((r, c))
                B[r][c] = '.'
            elif B1[r][c] == 'Z':
                z = (r, c)
                B[r][c] = '.'
            if B2[r][c].isdigit() and B2[r][c] > '0':
                capsules.append((r, c))
    
    # BFS1: infection time from z
    D1 = [[-1 for _ in range(13)] for _ in range(13)]
    if z:
        D1[z[0]][z[1]] = 0
        q = deque()
        q.append(z)
        dr = [-1, 0, 0, 1]
        dc = [0, -1, 1, 0]
        while q:
            cur = q.popleft()
            for k in range(4):
                nxt = (cur[0] + dr[k], cur[1] + dc[k])
                if B[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] != '.':
                    continue
                if D1[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] < 0:
                    D1[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] = D1[cur[0]][cur[1]] + 1
                    q.append(nxt)
    
    # BFS2: infection time from a scientist
    def bfs2(src):
        D2 = [[-1 for _ in range(13)] for _ in range(13)]
        D2[src[0]][src[1]] = 0
        q = deque()
        q.append(src)
        while q:
            cur = q.popleft()
            if D1[cur[0]][cur[1]] >= 0 and D2[cur[0]][cur[1]] >= D1[cur[0]][cur[1]]:
                continue
            for k in range(4):
                nxt = (cur[0] + dr[k], cur[1] + dc[k])
                if B[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] != '.':
                    continue
                if D2[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] < 0:
                    if D1[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] >= 0 and D1[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] < D2[cur[0]][cur[1]] + 1:
                        continue
                    D2[nxt[0]][nxt[1]] = D2[cur[0]][cur[1]] + 1
                    q.append(nxt)
        return D2
    
    SRC = 0
    SINK = len(scientists) + len(capsules) + 1
    
    # MaxFlow class implementation
    class MaxFlow:
        def __init__(self, N):
            self.N = N
            self.cap = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
            self.flow = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
        
        def add_edge(self, u, v, _cap):
            self.cap[u][v] += _cap
        
        def dinic(self, s, t):
            self.flow = [[0] * self.N for _ in range(self.N)]
            INF = 98765432
            
            def bfs(src, dst, path, mincap=0):
                bfs_par = [-1] * self.N
                bfs_D = [-1] * self.N
                bfs_D[src] = 0
                q = deque()
                q.append(src)
                while q:
                    cur = q.popleft()
                    if cur == dst:
                        cfp = INF
                        path.clear()
                        path.extend([0] * (bfs_D[dst] + 1))
                        path[bfs_D[dst]] = dst
                        curv = dst
                        for k in range(bfs_D[dst] - 1, -1, -1):
                            prev = bfs_par[curv]
                            cfp = min(cfp, self.cap[prev][curv] - self.flow[prev][curv])
                            curv = path[k] = prev
                        return cfp
                    for v in range(self.N):
                        if bfs_D[v] < 0 and self.cap[cur][v] - self.flow[cur][v] > mincap:
                            bfs_D[v] = bfs_D[cur] + 1
                            bfs_par[v] = cur
                            q.append(v)
                path.clear()
                return 0
            
            res = 0
            while True:
                path = []
                cfp = bfs(s, t, path)
                if not path:
                    break
                
                for w in range(self.N):
                    if bfs_D[w] >= 0 and self.cap[w][t] - self.flow[w][t] > 0:
                        cfp = self.cap[w][t] - self.flow[w][t]
                        curv = w
                        prev = bfs_par[w]
                        while prev >= 0:
                            cfp = min(cfp, self.cap[prev][curv] - self.flow[prev][curv])
                            curv = prev
                            prev = bfs_par[prev]
                        self.flow[w][t] += cfp
                        self.flow[t][w] = -self.flow[w][t]
                        curv = w
                        prev = bfs_par[w]
                        while prev >= 0:
                            self.flow[prev][curv] += cfp
                            self.flow[curv][prev] = -self.flow[prev][curv]
                            curv = prev
                            prev = bfs_par[prev]
                        res += cfp
            
            return res
    
    mf = MaxFlow(SINK + 1)
    
    for i, s in enumerate(scientists):
        mf.add_edge(SRC, i + 1, int(B1[s[0]][s[1]]))
    
    for j, c in enumerate(capsules):
        mf.add_edge(len(scientists) + j + 1, SINK, int(B2[c[0]][c[1]]))
    
    dr = [-1, 0, 0, 1]
    dc = [0, -1, 1, 0]
    
    for i, s in enumerate(scientists):
        D2 = bfs2(s)
        for j, c in enumerate(capsules):
            if D2[c[0]][c[1]] >= 0 and D2[c[0]][c[1]] <= T:
                mf.add_edge(i + 1, len(scientists) + j + 1, INF)
    
    res = mf.dinic(SRC, SINK)
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
